hint: Hold a plain major chord. Compare Soft Circuit and listen for changes in its pulse.
Try a simple C minor or A minor chord; compare with 12 EDO using a sustained sound. Listen for a gentle shimmer between the notes.
Sustain a major third, then move the chord up one key. Does it settle as easily?
Hold a root and a fifth, 11 keys apart. Move a middle note from 5 to 6 keys above the root; listen to the third widen.
Hold a root and a fifth, 18 keys apart. Add a note 10 keys above the root, then lower it one key. Listen to the change in tension.
Hold a root and a fifth, 13 keys apart. Move a middle note through 5, 6, 7, then 8 keys above the root. Compare the four chord colours.
Play a short melody over a drone. Repeat it seven keys higher and listen for the octave.
Hold a drone and explore one neighbouring key at a time. Repeat a phrase 13 keys higher: it returns above the octave.
